Assess the patient's social life, including their interactions, relationships, and support systems, to understand how these factors may influence their overall health and diabetes management. 2. 3. Engage in advanced care planning by identifying the necessity for surrogate decision-makers who can act on behalf of the patient if they become unable to make decisions themselves. 4. Discuss and establish advanced directives with the patient to document their preferences for medical care and treatment in situations where they may not be able to communicate their wishes.
